event.reason: The global event bus is its own family surface; no per-id operations exist.

health.reason: A single health probe belongs on the root client, not behind a one-method container.

session.reason: The session is the SDK's primary working object: two dozen operations chain on one sessionID (ADR-0019).

message.reason: Message operations are session-scoped and ride the session working object (ADR-0019).

shell.reason: A shell is a live process worked over its id: get, timeout, remove, and the pending output stream (ADR-0019).

integration.reason: The connect and oauth flows are multi-step conversations with one integration; six operations chain on integrationID (ADR-0019).

mcp.reason: The full pinned surface works one server by name - add, remove, connect, disconnect - a lifecycle, not a lookup (ADR-0019).

pty.reason: A pty is a live terminal worked over its id; the pinned surface adds update and connect operations to the trio (ADR-0019).

agent.reason: agent.get is the family's only per-id operation; a single lookup takes the id as an argument (ADR-0019).

credential.reason: Update and remove are single-shot admin actions; the id rides as an argument (ADR-0019).

permission.reason: saved.remove is the family's only per-id operation; the pending-request surface lives on sessions (ADR-0019).

provider.reason: provider.get is the family's only per-id operation; a single lookup takes the id as an argument (ADR-0019).

websearch.reason: Query and provider listing carry no per-id operations; a mass-noun container names the domain.
